screen.corner_order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left; points follow visible extent before rounding
screen.bottom_contour: Quadratic lower contour fitted to the complete native LED strokes

screen_measurement: Connected pale display pixels, luminance >100; masked to actual outline, camera excluded. Four corners are manual display boundary measurements for screenshot mapping.

rectification.method: Whole-device projective transform; same transform for screen opening. Alpha closing radius 3 px removes threshold pinholes.

tonal_adjustment: Smooth local keyboard exposure gain, increasing toward the underexposed right edge; no glyph reconstruction.
processing: Full source photograph rectification, explicit complete silhouette, bezel-only clone retouch and black lower display seam; no luminance-based erosion.
